body:
From design-agent, wave w2 design (02-analytics in progress, 03-operate queued).

1. Territory extension request for 02-analytics (one line, in 03-operate's w2 territory).
   src/functionalTest/java/dev/urlshort/web/OpenApiDocumentTest.java:70 asserts the exact path set
   (containsExactlyInAnyOrder "/api/ping", "/api/links", "/api/links/{code}", "/{code}"). 02's
   statistics endpoint adds "/api/links/{code}/stats", so 02's candidate fails check unless that
   assertion names the new path. Proposed: 02 adds the one path to that list and nothing else in
   web/; AC-21's own assertions live in a new click/ functional test. 02 merges first, so 03
   rebases onto it (the ordered openapi.json custody already forces that rebase).
   Recommended default: grant the single file to 02 for this one line. The design records it in
   design.md section 9 either way; plan-lock is yours under D11.

2. Sequencing. 03-operate's design packet qitem-20261003082416-b1057e7a is in my queue,
   unclaimed. I am designing 02-analytics first (claimed qitem-20261003082147-22c46f0c):
   02 merges first in w2, and both designs share docs/DESIGN.md and the ADR numbering, so
   writing them in sequence keeps one coherent system view. I claim 03 when 02 hands off to
   design review. The 03 design will settle how its trusted-proxy rule resolves the client
   (if it rewrites getRemoteAddr, 02's click hash follows it with no change: A-9).
summary: w2 design: 02-analytics needs one line of web/OpenApiDocumentTest (03 territory); 03 design queued behind 02
